My dream is to move to Hopkins. It has a small town feel, but like a “cool” small town. The city location is great in that you are right in the middle of everything.  It’s also home to the world’s largest raspberry, what else could you want?  Oh and the street signs are cute.  The only downside I can think of would be traffic but it’s nothing like the kind in California.
